params.name: icon

params.name: steps

default.title: Your AI, connected
default.say: Connect your AI lets an app such as Claude or ChatGPT work in {product} for you, for tests and demos: look things up and press the same buttons you would, as you. Signing in, payments and other people's steps stay with people.

default.title: Three steps, no typing
default.say: In your AI app, open its connectors and add a custom one. Paste this portal's address - the Copy button puts it on your clipboard. Press Connect: a window opens on this site, you sign in with your normal account and press Allow. No key, no terminal.

default.title: Live status
default.say: The status line turns green the moment your AI app first asks something, and names the app and when it last asked.

default.title: Check
default.say: Check runs a real question through the server - it answers, it lists its tools, a tool replies - and says in plain words which step fails, if any.

default.title: Connected apps
default.say: Every connected app is listed with how many questions it asked. Disconnect stops it at once, and asks first.

default.title: What it can do
default.say: These are the tools an AI app may use: reads look things up, changes press one of {product}'s own buttons, and the steps marked for a person are never done by a tool. Each can be switched off in People and access under Connect your AI.

default.title: For developers
default.say: An app that cannot sign in - a script, or Claude Code - can use a key instead. Keys are made under For developers, shown once, and revoked there.

params.label: The steps in order: title, say (the narration), target (where the spotlight goes; alternatives split by |, the first on screen wins), art (the picture: hero/flow/roads/meter/stack/check), place (below/above/right/left/center, optional), open (optional: what the guide presses first when the part is not on screen - open the first item, go back Home; alternatives split by |)
